summary: Defines a protocol that carries SS7 MTP2 user signaling messages over IP using SCTP. It runs between a Signaling Gateway, which receives SS7 signaling from the telephone network, and a Media Gateway Controller.

eli5.summary: The old phone network has its own language for setting up calls. This document lets those messages travel across the internet so old and new systems can still talk.

questions: how is ss7 carried over ip with sctp
